monthClose.title: Month-end close
monthClose.subtitle: Each month's checklist is done by one person and checked by another, then the month is locked · nothing can be posted into a locked month
monthClose.noPeriods: No financial year is open for this company
monthClose.noPeriodsBody: Admin opens the financial year on Numbering & IDs; its twelve months then appear here.

banner.body: Every task is done by one person and checked by another, or moved to next month with a reason. Then the month is closed and nothing dated in it can be posted.

monthClose.closeEffect: Locks {{month}}. No entry dated in it can be added, edited or cancelled by anyone, under any right, until Admin reopens it with a reason.
monthClose.noChecklist: No checklist for this month yet
monthClose.noChecklistBody: Open the checklist to list the standard month-end tasks. Each task then needs a doer and a different checker.
monthClose.noChecklistClosed: This month was closed without a checklist on this screen.
monthClose.needRight: Opening the checklist needs the month-end close right. Ask Admin.
monthClose.openHint: The standard tasks are added from Settings. Choose who does and who checks them, or leave both to any finance manager; the doer and the checker must be different people.
monthClose.doneByMe: Done by you on {{when}} · someone else checks it

return.title: Send back: {{title}}
return.hint: Say what needs fixing. The task goes back to open for the doer.

carry.title: Move to next month: {{title}}
carry.hint: The task is added to next month's checklist and this one is marked as moved.

assign.title: Assign: {{title}}
assign.hint: The doer and the checker must be different people.

monthClose.reopenHint: Only Admin can reopen a month. The reason goes to the user log, and the month can be set to lock again after a number of hours (Settings).
monthClose.noClosed: No month of this company is closed.

after.title: After the lock
after.one: No one can add, edit or cancel an entry dated in a locked month, whatever right or special permission they hold.
after.two: A late bill goes into the open month, with the original bill date kept for GST.
after.three: Admin can reopen a month with a reason; it is logged and can lock again automatically after the hours in Settings.
after.four: Every close, reopen and relock is kept in the month's history and the user log.
